==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will only use this skill against foes using a skill. They occasionally use it when the target's skill is too close to completion for the secondary effect to activate.

==Notes==
* Unlike [[Mistrust]], this hex does not apply the direct damage the next time the target activates a skill. The direct damage is applied only if this hex is cast while the target is activating a skill.
* This is an excellent [[cover]] hex due to the short casting time, which makes it hard for foes to remove the hex before the cover hex has been applied.
{{bug|The damage multiplier of 75% also applies to target foe.}}
